website_metadata.notes: IFSC Banking Unit (GIFT City), parent CTBC Bank Co. Ltd. The parent deposit-rates page (https://www.ctbcbank.bank.in/content/dam/cbminisite/IN/deposit-rates.html, AEM minisite) is behind a WAF: returns HTTP 202 with an ~18KB JS challenge/incident page (no rate data) to browser-UA curl, and 'Access Denied' to Playwright headless render. CTBC's GIFT IBU is corporate/wholesale-focused; foreign-currency term-deposit rates appear quoted on inquiry rather than published. A companion _gift_rates.json exists with the same finding.

warnings: Parent deposit-rates AEM page WAF-blocked (HTTP 202 challenge page / Access Denied to headless).
GIFT IBU deposits are foreign-currency and NOT DICGC-insured; no published retail rate card surfaced.
